text: Krasicki Estate Clock commission WH-2026-029. Escape wheel ordered from Stefan Muller (Muller Uhrenteile AG). Quoted EUR 645.00. Parts subtotal PLN 2799.30 at prior EUR/PLN rate 4.34 (September close booking). Expected delivery 2026-10-26. 50% deposit (EUR 322.50) paid September.

Comparable past assessments. Black Forest longcase movements typically estimated at workshop margin 35% over parts cost. Prior 1840s German movement assessments referenced here. Polish longcase (Krasicki/Radziwill) tracked separately.
